name: charmap-select
description: Sub-recipe: click Select on Character Map and check the 'Characters to copy' edit took the glyph.
notes: Sub-recipe: no launch block, so it runs against whatever Character Map window is up. Select appends the currently highlighted grid cell, so the check is `contains`, not an exact value, and replay stays green (measured: '!\r' -> '!!\r'). The grid itself is custom-drawn, so this cannot choose a different glyph by name - see apps/character-map.md.
